decisions.reason: Location-specific branding does not change the master hub's location listing, routing, or navigation behavior.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording template reuse and location-specific branding and wording customization.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that packages and prices remain consistent across location sites; the branding change requires no additional booking-state update.
Reusing the website design with location-specific branding does not alter separate booking, payout, calendar, revenue, or sales management per location.
The client requires the same website design throughout the master and location websites, extending the visual design direction beyond its prior master-site-only scope.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Well it’s really creating one type of website that is the same thru out all websites which we copy and paste and just change branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same
